bug_semantics: Community-tier Harden-Runner (non-TLS `step-security/agent`) enforces `egress-policy: block` with iptables ACCEPT-then-REJECT on OUTPUT/DOCKER-USER. In `addBlockRules`, hardcoded public resolvers (originally 8.8.8.8; later also 8.8.4.4 and 1.1.1.1) were ACCEPTed for all TCP with no `--dport` and no `--uid-owner`. The local DNS proxy listens only on UDP (`127.0.0.1:53` and `172.17.0.1:53`, `Net: "udp"`) and the audit/proxy path drops UDP/53, not TCP/53. A process with workflow code execution can therefore send DNS-over-TCP (`dig +tcp @8.8.8.8`) to those resolvers and get outbound communication that evades `allowed-endpoints`. Enterprise `agent-ebpf` (TLS path) is not this sink.
flaw_origin: The unrestricted TCP ACCEPT to the resolver IP was first written in step-security/agent `c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6` (`First commit`, 2021-11-16) in `firewall.go` `addBlockRules`: comment `Agent uses HTTPs to resolve domain names` / `Allow 8.8.8.8 for dns` then `ipt.Append(..., protocol, tcp, destination, dnsServerIP, target, accept)` with no destination port. Parent `794340760181b0a57396ae8eaa9a3235f472994e` is the GitHub `Initial commit` (LICENSE/README/.gitignore only); `firewall.go` is absent there. Later public history only widened the same hole (v0.13.3 added 8.8.4.4; #414 looped 8.8.8.8/8.8.4.4/1.1.1.1) without adding port or UID constraints.

Parent 794340760181b0a57396ae8eaa9a3235f472994e tree is only .gitignore/LICENSE/README.md; `git cat-file -e c793555^:firewall.go` fails. Root is not an orphan of the BIC; parent tree verified. No finer public member: 'First commit' is the first code drop of the agent.

Attack-path corroboration in the same agent: main.go starts dns.Server Addr 127.0.0.1:53 and 172.17.0.1:53 with Net="udp" only; dnsconfig.go forces systemd-resolved DNS=127.0.0.1; AddAuditRules drops UDP/53 (and historically all UDP) but never TCP/53. So dig +tcp to the always-allowed resolver IPs bypasses both the UDP proxy and allowed-endpoints.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: GHSA-g699-3x6g-wm3g / CVE-2026-32946 is a real published Community-tier egress bypass, not withdrawn. The sink is not in the harden-runner TypeScript wrapper; that repo only downloads the community agent binary. The flawed mechanism is agent firewall.go addBlockRules granting all TCP to public resolvers so the agent could do HTTPS DNS, which also permits DNS-over-TCP from any UID. BIC search used git log -S/-L on firewall.go in the public step-security/agent history, not an AI-marker hunt. The smallest first-write of those ACCEPT lines is c793555; its parent tree lacks firewall.go, so the lines are new there. Subsequent IP-list expansions are not first-writes of the mechanism. AI is judged only on that BIC object: human Varun Sharma, 2021-11-16, no commit-object AI marker, therefore NOT_AI. The advisory-product fix is harden-runner v2.16.0 fa2e9d6 (agent 0.14.3→0.14.4 pin); the direct mechanism fix is agent 7edc21b, merged as 206a878 / v0.14.4, which tightens the resolver allow to agent UID and TCP/443 so DNS-over-TCP no longer matches.
